scope: Two ordered fresh-server cells, same original eight wire requests/source/profile/model. DRAFT_MODE is the controlled cell difference. Observation adds no model requests. No claim of performance timing or generic schema correctness.
findings: All eight target-only requests emit the complete altered spelling thinkaliteralthink by actual processed token14, with zero content filters and before any force or phase event.
Target-only budgeted four force after token24 and attach grammar after forced close token25; unbudgeted four never close reasoning or attach grammar and reach length256.
MTP first three show the same pre-intervention altered spelling by token14, then budget forcing24/closure25.

MTP remaining five naturally emit native closing ID248069 at token16 while describing a quoted marker value; the guard admits closure and grammar attaches immediately. Four later fail the exact value and one passes. The trace establishes the transition, not intended meaning of the quote.
No observed prefix requires rewind reconstruction in this run. Native text equals backend text in all16 records; each reconstructed pre-intervention token prefix is an exact native-text prefix.
The evidence justifies a separate explicitly changed-input ordinary-BPE user-span experiment. It does not justify silently changing a production tokenizer or a quote/nesting heuristic.
